sentences.text: South Australia’s Independent Commissioner Against Corruption evaluated the regulatory arm of SafeWork SA to identify ways to reduce corruption and other integrity risks.
sentences.support:
The recommendations are intended to advance comprehensive and effective 
systems for preventing or minimising corruption, misconduct and maladministration in 
public administration.

sentences.text: The evaluation examined governance, policies, inspections, investigations, staff management and information controls.
sentences.support:
That SafeWork SA provides management training to all existing managers and 
team leaders

sentences.text: The Commissioner concluded that weak policies, poor oversight and limited understanding of risks exposed the agency to corruption, misconduct and maladministration.
sentences.support:
All of these factors create a working environment at serious risk of corruption, 
misconduct and maladministration.

sentences.text: The Commissioner also found that a communication barrier prevented safety risks identified by education staff from reaching regulatory inspectors.
sentences.support:
One of the most significant findings in this evaluation has been the intentional 
creation of a communication barrier

sentences.text: The Commissioner made 39 recommendations covering communication, governance, inspection safeguards, investigations, training and confidential information.
sentences.support:
I have made 39 recommendations as a consequence of 
this evaluation.

findings.quote:
All of these factors create a working environment at serious risk of corruption, 
misconduct and maladministration.

One of the most significant findings in this evaluation has been the intentional 
creation of a communication barrier between SafeWork SA’s educator arm and its 
regulatory arm.

notes: Recommendations are formally addressed to the Chief Executive of the Department of Treasury and Finance and concern agency systems, not findings against particular staff.
